title: Disinterment of USS Arizona Unknowns Begins in Honolulu
detail: On November 2, 2026, disinterment of unidentified USS Arizona casualties began at the National Memorial Cemetery of the Pacific in Honolulu, with the first eight caskets removed for forensic identification work ahead of the 85th anniversary of the Pearl Harbor attack.

sources.name: National WWII Museum — Disinterment of USS Arizona Unknowns Begins ahead of Pearl Harbor Anniversary

media.caption: USS Arizona unknowns disinterment begins, Honolulu.
